name: apple-mail
description: Read, search, compose, and send emails via Apple Mail on macOS.
long_description: Local MCP server for Apple Mail on macOS. Uses AppleScript to list mailboxes, search and read messages, compose drafts, and send email — all with Apple Mail as the system of record. Requires macOS and Apple Mail installed.

mail_safety_mode.title: Mail safety mode
mail_safety_mode.description: Type exactly one of: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access. safe_readonly: read and search only. safe_manage: also drafts, replies and forwards (these send immediately), mark, move, delete, and archive. full_access: also sends new messages. This bundle's default is full_access, matching earlier bundle releases (uvx and pip installs default to safe_manage). Sets APPLE_MAIL_MCP_SAFETY_PROFILE.

mail_allowed_attachment_root.title: Mail attachment folder
mail_allowed_attachment_root.description: Optional. Mail drafts and sends can attach files only from this folder; pick a dedicated folder, not your home folder. Leave empty to keep attachments turned off. Sets APPLE_MAIL_MCP_ALLOWED_ATTACHMENT_ROOT.

mail_visible_drafts.title: Show Mail drafts on screen
mail_visible_drafts.description: Open new drafts in a visible Mail window so you can review them. Sets APPLE_MAIL_MCP_VISIBLE_DRAFTS.
